exposure: uterine niches (cavity formed at cesarean scar site)
chronic inflammatory changes at niche site
surgical interventions (hysteroscopy, laparoscopy, or combined surgery)
outcome: impact on assisted reproduction technology (ART) outcomes
efficacy of surgical interventions in restoring fertility
cohort: The study synthesized findings from studies involving women with uterine niches.
finding: The incidence of secondary infertility in women with uterine niches ranged from 27.37% to 75%, with decreased residual myometrial thickness, chronic inflammatory changes, and fluid accumulation identified as leading causes, and surgical interventions showing differing efficacies in restoring fertility.
mod_finding: The rising trend of cesarean sections worldwide has resulted in an increased incidence of uterine niches, which are associated with secondary infertility.
